description: This file defines the `TranscriptsStore` actor which manages a capped log of transcript entries stored in a file within the user's Application Support directory. It provides methods to append new entries and retrieve the latest entries, as well as an extension to `String` for appending lines to a file.

classes.name: TranscriptsStore
classes.description: An actor managing a limited set of transcript entries stored persistently in a log file, supporting singleton access via `shared`.

classes.name: String
classes.description: An extension adding a private method to append lines to a file.

methods.name: init()
methods.description: Initializes the `TranscriptsStore` by setting up the directory, loading existing entries from the log file, and maintaining a maximum of `limit` entries.

methods.name: append(text:)
methods.description: Appends a new transcript entry, maintains the maximum limit, and writes the updated entries to disk.

methods.name: latest()
methods.description: Returns the current list of transcript entries.

methods.name: appendLine(to:)
methods.description: Private String extension method to append a line to the specified file URL.
